sections.heading: Where MyRecon differs from Osintgram
sections.body: While Osintgram focuses on its own specialized workflow, MyRecon brings cross-platform username sweeps (560+ to 3,000+ sites), free email exposure checks, DNS/IP lookups, and Deep Search into one browser and Android interface with transparent pricing.

sections.heading: Black Friday 2026 pricing comparison
sections.body: During the Black Friday sale, MyRecon Pro drops from $4.99/month to $3.99/month (20% off) and from $39.99/year to $19.99/year (50% off, or ₹299/mo and ₹1,999/yr in India). New subscribers get a 7-day free trial with 3 Extended scans and Deep Search.

sections.heading: Handling false positives and unresolved checks
sections.body: Any OSINT tool can hit rate limits or login walls. MyRecon marks ambiguous responses as unknown instead of guessing, and encourages opening the original source URL to verify bios, dates, and linked domains.

sections.heading: When to choose Osintgram vs MyRecon
sections.body: Keep Osintgram if its specific data source or CLI automation is essential to your pipeline. Choose MyRecon when you want fast browser-based username and email OSINT, Android portability, and low-cost Black Friday Pro pricing.

faq.question: Is MyRecon a good Osintgram alternative?
faq.answer: Yes, especially if you want a browser-based OSINT toolkit covering 560+ to 3,000+ username platforms, free email breach checks, and Deep Search without complex setup.

faq.question: How much does MyRecon cost compared to enterprise OSINT tools?
faq.answer: MyRecon has a permanent Free tier (5 Standard scans/day + free email lookups). During Black Friday, Pro is $3.99/month or $19.99/year (50% off) with a 7-day free trial.

faq.question: Can I use both tools together?
faq.answer: Yes. Many investigators run MyRecon for rapid cross-platform username and email pivoting, then cross-check specialized findings in complementary tools.

faq.question: Does MyRecon require installing Python or CLI packages?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs in your web browser or the official Android app on Google Play.
